question: Do Q170-Q179 plus local finite K4 geometry force irreversible capture, or only constrain its receipts?

objects.definition: 1-to-4 centroid subdivision of [0123] with new vertex 4 and four tetrahedra
objects.coefficient_domain: Z for incidence; Q for stocks

assumptions: No physical time or SI energy mapping; real unit H=I
The candidate retained stock r_tau is an additional variable not derived from Q170-Q179
Candidate transfer fraction delta_sigma may range from 0 to c_sigma^2; event trigger and irreversibility not supplied
Single-simplex capture event changes c amplitude and is separate from continuous skew flow
Closed finite 3-ball: no net boundary flux in the toy preparation

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: compare direct dS/dt with Q179 signed current

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: f=(5,10,10,4), sum=29; shared face incident to 2 tetra so 1/2+1/2=1

factor_origins: unit squared face and coface amplitudes
integer_fraction_receipt.divisibility_gcd_lcm: each counted simplex has n3>=1; ownership sums to one

clock_receipt.update_rule: between events c'=(d-d^T)c; candidate event c_sigma'^2=c_sigma^2−δ, r_tau'=r_tau+wδ
clock_receipt.coupling: unit incidence; no sourced transfer law

known_targets: source Q177-179 exact ownership and signed current
fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: δ=0 null and δ=1 full-capture counterexample selected for distinguishability; not physically derived

target_exposure.selection_criterion: check nonnegative exact continuity, disprove uniqueness by two distinct admissible transfers

calculation_steps: Build four K4 3-cells and 29 unique oriented simplices
define signed lower→upper J=-2 B c_sigma c_eta
derive dS_tau/du =Σ (w_eta−w_sigma)J and independently compute direct derivative
show shared face and coface preparation yields signed cell derivative (-1,1,0,0)
introduce candidate transfer δ∈[0,c_sigma²]; prove S'_tau+r'_tau=S_tau+r_tau
test δ=0 and δ=1: totals remain 2, retained totals 0 or 1 respectively
conclude nonunique retention selection and lack of persistence theorem

result.exact_expression: sum_tau(S_tau+r_tau) invariant at every candidate transfer; δ=0 and δ=1 both valid under same source accounting
result.units: native squared chain amplitude, no physical SI
result.scope: one-event conditional transfer on 1-to-4 K4 under fixed unit metric; not source-native material selection

29 simplex event cases separately checked local; committed test-script replay not yet independently reviewed

one-event capture does not suppress continuing incidence transport or prove retained-state attraction
signed current Q179 alone can circulate in both directions and lacks an irreversible arrow
limitations: No source-selected transfer fraction, event threshold, reverse law, clock or physical energy metric
Q170-Q179 exact allocation and current are not a constitutive retention generator
No physical particle, charge or mass identification; non-constructor review NOT_RUN
